title: LegacyModern AI Behavioral Contract
description: Business rules and executable input/output assertions extracted from a legacy module. Produced by the Gemini ingest agent, verified by the spec publisher, consumed by templates/characterization_test.go. Numeric parity rules: JSON numbers and decimal strings (e.g. "5.01") are compared as exact decimals; the effective tolerance is the assertion's tolerance or defaultTolerance; actual values may not carry more decimal places than tolerance.scale. Mirrors BehavioralContractSchema in mcp_bridge/src/types.ts.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version; minor bumps when assertions change, patch when only verification metadata changes

verifiedBy.description: null until the spec publisher signs off; characterization tests must refuse unverified contracts in CI

file.description: Path relative to the ingested subsystem root

symbol.description: Paragraph, procedure, field or method name

scale.description: Decimal places carried by the legacy field (2 for PIC S9(9)V99)

operation.description: Name of the modern operation registered in the characterization harness

inputs.description: Input vector keyed by modern field name

initialState.description: Entity state before the call, e.g. {"account": {"status": "CURRENT"}}

outputs.description: Exact output map; extra or missing keys fail parity. Empty when error is set

stateTransitions.description: Every state change the call must make; any undeclared change fails parity

stringComparison.description: rtrim mirrors COBOL PIC X space padding

findings: Added A-007 (rounding drives the fee-assessed flag) and A-014 (validation precedence) which the ingest pass omitted.
Confirmed COMPUTE ROUNDED default mode is NEAREST-AWAY-FROM-ZERO; balances are non-negative after validation so HALF_UP is equivalent.
DRY RUN 2026-10-13: source hashes and line counts re-confirmed (LNFEE010.cbl 105 lines, LNFEEREC.cpy 24 lines).
Added A-019..A-024 (validation precedence INVALID_STATUS > CLOSED > NEGATIVE_BALANCE > INVALID_DAYS_PAST_DUE, PIC 9(4) max 9999, case-sensitive and all-spaces status).

Added A-025 (fee rounds to zero at 0.01), A-026 (escalation independent of fee), A-027 (rounding lands exactly on cap), A-028/A-029 (charge-off boundary at 89/90), A-030 (space-padded PIC X(10) input status), A-031 (CHARGEOFF at 120 days, equal-rank no-change).
A-004 boundary corrected kind max -> precision_edge: 500.00 is not the largest uncapped balance (500.09 -> raw 25.0045 -> 25.00 at line 66); expected values unchanged.
A-005 boundary corrected kind max_plus_one -> precision_edge: first capped balance is 500.10 (raw 25.005 -> 25.01 > cap at line 68), not 500.20; expected values unchanged.
A-007 lineage corrected: added src/LNFEE010.cbl:64-76 and 15-19, since the 0.0045 -> 0.00 rounding that decides the flag happens at line 66, not in lines 73-75.
A-015, A-016, A-021, A-022 copybook lineage corrected to the balance (LNFEEREC.cpy:8) and days-past-due (LNFEEREC.cpy:9) fields instead of the status 88-levels.
All 31 assertions confirmed by executing LNFEE010 compiled with GnuCOBOL 3.1.2 (cobc -x -fstatic-call) on 2026-10-13; a 202,730-record dual-engine replay against the Go service matched 100%.

businessRules.description: Late fee calculation: after a 15-day grace period, fee = 5% of outstanding balance rounded half-up to 2 decimals (COMPUTE ROUNDED), capped at 25.00.
Fee-assessed indicator: LN-FEE-ASSESSED is 'Y' only when the rounded fee is greater than zero.
Delinquency escalation: >=30 days -> DELINQUENT, >=90 days -> CHARGEOFF; status only escalates, never downgrades.
Input validation, first failure wins: invalid status (RC 08), CLOSED account (RC 12), negative balance (RC 08), days past due > 999 (RC 08).

assertions.description: Captured nightly-cycle record: 100.10 balance, 20 days past due; 5.005 rounds half-up to 5.01
Day 15 is the last day of the grace period: no fee

boundary.rationale: IF LN-DAYS-PAST-DUE > WS-GRACE-DAYS uses strict greater-than (line 65)

assertions.description: Day 16 is the first chargeable day

boundary.rationale: First value past the grace boundary

assertions.description: 500.00 balance produces exactly the 25.00 cap

boundary.rationale: Raw fee 25.00 equals WS-FEE-CAP; IF WS-RAW-FEE > WS-FEE-CAP (line 68) is false at equality. Not the max: 500.01-500.09 also round to <= 25.00 (line 66)

assertions.description: 500.20 balance yields raw fee 25.01 which is capped to 25.00

boundary.rationale: Raw fee 25.01 > WS-FEE-CAP (line 68) so the cap is moved (line 69). The first capped balance is 500.10 (raw 25.005 rounds to 25.01 at line 66)

assertions.description: 0.10 balance: raw 0.005 rounds half-up to 0.01

boundary.rationale: COMPUTE ROUNDED rounds away from zero at the half (line 66)

assertions.description: 0.09 balance: raw 0.0045 rounds to 0.00 so no fee is flagged

boundary.rationale: Fee-assessed flag depends on the rounded fee, not the raw product

assertions.description: Zero balance past grace: fee 0.00 and flag stays N
30 days past due escalates CURRENT to DELINQUENT
90 days past due escalates DELINQUENT to CHARGEOFF
Status never downgrades: CHARGEOFF at 20 days stays CHARGEOFF
29 days past due is one day short of delinquency
Status outside the 88-level LN-STATUS-VALID set is rejected with RC 08
CLOSED is checked before balance sign: closed account with negative balance returns RC 12
Negative balance is rejected with RC 08
Days past due above 999 overflow the business range and are rejected
999 days is the largest accepted value and escalates straight to CHARGEOFF
Captured record at the PIC S9(9)V99 ceiling: fee capped, status unchanged
Invalid status wins over every other failure: FROZEN with negative balance and 1000 days returns INVALID_STATUS RC 08
CLOSED is checked before the days range: CLOSED account with 1000 days past due returns ACCOUNT_CLOSED RC 12
Negative balance is checked before the days range: -0.01 with 1000 days returns NEGATIVE_BALANCE RC 08
9999 days, the largest value PIC 9(4) can hold, is rejected with INVALID_DAYS_PAST_DUE RC 08

boundary.rationale: LN-DAYS-PAST-DUE PIC 9(4) (copybook line 9) caps the input at 9999; WHEN LN-DAYS-PAST-DUE > WS-MAX-DAYS (line 56) rejects it

assertions.description: Status comparison is case-sensitive: lowercase 'current' is not in LN-STATUS-VALID and returns INVALID_STATUS RC 08
An all-spaces status (uninitialised PIC X(10)) is not in LN-STATUS-VALID and returns INVALID_STATUS RC 08

boundary.rationale: WHEN NOT LN-STATUS-VALID (line 47); 88-level values on copybook lines 15-18 do not include SPACES

assertions.description: Smallest positive balance 0.01 past grace: raw 0.0005 rounds to 0.00 so no fee is flagged

boundary.rationale: COMPUTE WS-RAW-FEE ROUNDED (line 66) yields 0.00; IF LN-LATE-FEE > ZERO (line 73) is false

assertions.description: Status escalates even when no fee is charged: 0.00 balance at 30 days moves CURRENT to DELINQUENT with fee 0.00 and flag N
499.90 balance: raw 24.995 rounds half-up to exactly the 25.00 cap and is moved unchanged

boundary.rationale: COMPUTE ROUNDED (line 66) lands on 25.00; IF WS-RAW-FEE > WS-FEE-CAP (line 68) is false at equality

assertions.description: DELINQUENT at 89 days stays DELINQUENT: one day short of charge-off

boundary.rationale: WHEN LN-DAYS-PAST-DUE >= WS-CHARGEOFF-DAYS (line 83) is false; new rank 1 is not > current rank 1 (line 98)

assertions.description: CURRENT at exactly 90 days skips DELINQUENT and escalates straight to CHARGEOFF

boundary.rationale: WHEN LN-DAYS-PAST-DUE >= WS-CHARGEOFF-DAYS (line 83) uses >=; rank 2 > rank 0 (line 98)

assertions.description: Fixed-width input status 'CURRENT   ' (PIC X(10) padding) is valid and escalates to DELINQUENT at 30 days
Status must not change at equal rank: CHARGEOFF at 120 days stays CHARGEOFF while the 15.00 fee is still assessed
